Meta and Sierra published an open sign-in standard for AI agents.

• OAuth-based: you pick read-only or write access
• Draft only: spec due this month, no payments, OpenAI and Anthropic not listed

Source: Sierra and Meta, Oct 6

Follow @theaidesk.io for more AI updates!
